reason: A target-service memory fault exhausted the bounded request queue and the load process exited, creating a 25-second demand-intent ledger gap.

semantics.admitted_arrivals: Arrivals submitted to the bounded request executor.
semantics.backpressure_rejected_arrivals: Demand intentions not submitted because the bounded executor was full.
semantics.scheduled_arrivals: All deterministic open-loop demand intentions, equal to admitted plus backpressure-rejected arrivals.

invariants: The target arrival schedule, behavior weights, load profile identity, request timeout, worker count, and maximum pending bound are unchanged.
Backpressure never fabricates a completed request or metric observation.
Backpressure accounting remains explicit in each immutable five-second intent record.
The load process and intent ledger remain continuous while a target service is unavailable.
The failed V000014 attempt-1 remains preserved and excluded from the accepted campaign datasets.
